scenarios.prompt: Plan a one-file configuration change in a repository that already contains the required pattern.

acceptance_checks.description: The exact file, no-go scope, and success condition are frozen.
The approach cites current repository evidence rather than durable context alone.
The plan rejects unnecessary abstraction and keeps the change to one slice.

scenarios.prompt: Fix a null-input regression with a reproducible failure and an existing narrow test seam.

acceptance_checks.description: Evidence reproduces the failure before the correction.
The correction addresses the proven cause rather than the symptom.
A focused test fails before and passes after the correction.
Unrelated files and dirty work remain untouched.

scenarios.prompt: Add a permission-gated operation with explicit allow and deny behavior.

acceptance_checks.description: The authorization boundary and owner are explicit.
The allowed path is proven.
The denied path is proven without weakening the guard.
The user-visible or API behavior is verified at the owning seam.

scenarios.prompt: Review a proposal whose recorded head differs from the current remote head.

acceptance_checks.description: The immutable target mismatch is detected.
The review does not approve stale evidence.
The report names the head mismatch and required refresh.

scenarios.prompt: Triage a security-sensitive migration while the fast profile is selected.

acceptance_checks.description: The security and migration triggers are identified.
Fast triage does not imply formal approval.
The result requires the full profile before a decision.

scenarios.prompt: Complete a routine task whose evidence does not support a reusable learning rule.

acceptance_checks.description: The final-head learning audit ran.
The candidate list is empty instead of inventing a lesson.
No repository instruction, skill, or memory was mutated.

scenarios.prompt: Complete a task with repeated current-run evidence for one narrow reusable rule.

acceptance_checks.description: The proposed rule cites current-run receipts.
The scope and revalidation trigger are explicit.
The candidate remains proposed and performs no durable write.

scenarios.prompt: Reconcile a worker result that changed a file outside its writable scope.

acceptance_checks.description: The out-of-scope path is identified.
The controller rejects the worker completion claim.
The controller does not overwrite or revert unrelated work.

scenarios.prompt: Plan a small UI null-guard fix but leave an acceptance criterion without any proof mapping.

acceptance_checks.description: READY is refused when a success criterion lacks step/proof linkage.
The residual or validator names the missing acceptance_trace linkage.

scenarios.prompt: Complete a task whose closure drops a finding without naming it in correction receipts.

acceptance_checks.description: A finding that disappears across closure iterations is named in corrections or the run does not COMPLETE.
The task validator rejects silent finding drops.

scenarios.prompt: Plan with a material assumption accepted without decision_reason or evidence.

acceptance_checks.description: ACCEPTED assumptions require decision_reason or evidence_ids before READY.
Bare acceptance without reason does not pass the plan validator.

scenarios.prompt: Attempt COMPLETE with plan.validator_receipt VALID while the freeze on disk is NOT_CONFIDENT.

acceptance_checks.description: Parent re-opens plan.freeze_path and rejects non-READY freezes.
A bare VALID receipt string is insufficient for COMPLETE.
